comment: Coverage scope is the domain and serving surface: shared builders/contracts, the browser data+logic layer, and the Pages Functions. `all: true` counts files the tests never import, so an untested module shows as 0% instead of vanishing from the report.

scripts/ and .github/scripts/ are deliberately out of scope: they are CLI entrypoints whose bodies are argument parsing and R2 I/O, and DB-MASTER-PLAN Phase 7 deletes a large share of them. Their extracted logic already lives in shared/ and is measured here.
src/**/*.tsx is out of scope: components need a browser, and their behavior is covered by the Playwright suites rather than by node:test.
Thresholds are set at the measured baseline (see the coverage:check script), not at an aspirational round number. Raise them as logic moves out of the excluded roots.
